english.note: Use 牌子 as the all-purpose choice when “make” means a product brand or make.
Choose 牌子 in casual speech when asking or talking about which product brand something is.

examples.english: Do you know what make this phone is?
examples.traditional: 你知唔知呢部電話係咩牌子？
examples.jyutping: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 hai6 me1 paai4 zi2

examples.english: Which brand of shampoo do you usually buy?
examples.traditional: 你平時買邊個牌子嘅洗頭水？
examples.jyutping: nei5 ping4 si4 maai5 bin1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 sai2 tau4 seoi2
